'''Sljee''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ehosiq sector]]. [[Species/Legends|Species]] living on it, which included the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sljee (species)|Sljee]], [[Olfax|primarily relied]] on the sense of smell. Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Sljee was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
Sljee was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="AE" /> located in the [[Sljee system/Legends|Sljee system]]. It was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Ehosiq sector]], being located both in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of that region.<ref name="Location" /> The planet was situated on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Kiros system/Legends|Kiros]] and [[Nessem system/Legends|Nessem systems]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
A [[Unidentified Sljee|Sljee waiter]] who worked on<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]<ref name="HSR" /> by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures|''The Han Solo Adventures'']] trilogy, which includes ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', to between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> hailed from Sljee.<ref name="CSWE Sljee">{{CSWECite|III|168|Sljee}}</ref> Sljee fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Sljee (species)}}
[[File:Sljee-AE.png|thumb|right|300px|Sljee was the homeworld of the species of the same name.]]
Sljee was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Sljee (species)|same name]],<ref name="AE" /> members of which communicated in the [[Sljee (language)|Sljee]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="CCW" /> Species on Sljee [[Olfax|primarily relied]] on the sense of smell, with scent being of utmost importance in both [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] prey and evading [[Diet/Legends|predators]]. The olfactory apparatus of the Sljee was fine-tuned to identify a very specific range of scents, including those of other Sljee and [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] sources from their homeworld. Consequently, those Sljee who traveled offworld were frequently bewildered and overwhelmed by the unfamiliar smells that could be encountered in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The Sljee were a communal species, and as such, when away from Sljee, they commonly lived in groups.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sljee was introduced in the [[1984]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' by [[Raymond L. Velasco]].<ref name="Guide1">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Sljee [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square M-8.<ref name="TEA Sljee" />
